notes: skills/ deletes are legitimate — the prefix guard allows skills/ and topics/ both — so all three seeded ids succeed and the contract, not the tool, is what refuses the two wrong ones. The default matters more here than anywhere else in the suite: a model that never calls list_memory has no way to learn the skill's real id and will guess one (skills/youtube-discovery-source.md, skills/youtube-followed-sources.md), and the default turns that guess into a graded tool_error rather than a lucky hit.
